dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm? You seem tired. Run into some trouble, perhaps?

choices.text: Nothing but the usual minor problems one runs into while on the road.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Such strength... Still, it is best not to push yourself too hard.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Take a short break today. There are leaves nearby — I'd be happy to play you a tune.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: May its melody accompany you — from where the wind blows, and into the distant future.

choices.text: My recent travels have been rather tiring...

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I understand. Though we may think ourselves accustomed to a life of wandering, there will always be times when we cannot help but sigh.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Of course, the day may come when we miss our days as wayfarers, even should we find a place to settle down. No life has ever been lived in perfect bliss.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Do you also get tired, Kazuha?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Of course. Not all the paths I've tread were smooth going.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: When a bad mood strikes, troubles soon follow in their twos and threes, with nostalgia not far behind... A wanderer yearning for home is like a bird pining for the old forest.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: But once these troubles pass, the journey continues once more. Having experienced this again and again, I've come to realize something—

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: The world is vast, and setbacks inevitable, but a clear heart fears not inclement weather.
